proposition: In Nafsat II Ibn Turka claims that envoys from India and Anatolia sought copies of his works and that his students are scattered across Shiraz, Samarkand, Anatolia and India; this is self-report and self-praise.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing from exile to Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh
Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
